summary: Iteration 5 — Frontend re-test after the StrictMode race fix in SharedLeadDetail.jsx (mount-duration guard). RESULT: The critical bug from iteration_4 is FIXED. Agents can now open shared-lead detail pages end-to-end. All PRIORITY-1 flows pass. Also verified: 2-agent 'In use by' interlock, BoB effective-date filter query params, and the new quick-status-{id} testid (code-verified; agent1 had no assigned leads in test data so no live DOM element to click but the testid is correctly present in Leads.jsx line 420).

issues: Name column shows '—' instead of the completed client's full_name for freshly Completed shared leads. The lead is correctly recorded (phone/birthdate/city all show), but the NAME cell renders a dash. Likely a display-mapping bug in BookOfBusiness.jsx — completed_by_name flows correctly but the lead's full_name may not be projected to the row's name cell. Low priority since data is present in DB.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In Book of Business list, ensure the NAME column renders lead.full_name (currently shows '—' for completed shared leads). Data is present server-side; likely a small mapping fix in BookOfBusiness.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: SharedLeadDetail.jsx: The mount-duration guard `if (Date.now() - mountedAt < 500) return;` is placed inside the cleanup RETURN, so it correctly no-ops the StrictMode double-invoke cleanup while still releasing on genuine unmount >500ms after mount. beforeunload handler is unaffected. Clean, minimal patch.

Note: In dev-StrictMode the network trace still shows 3× POST /lock (initial mount + strict-remount + heartbeat setup) before the GET — 200s all around because lock is idempotent. Not a bug, but a small wasted round-trip.
quick-status-{id} testid confirmed at Leads.jsx:420 and quick-status-opt-{leadId}-{StatusName} at line 424.
